messages.author: 2f3a6bdbc087eaa4
messages.subject: User Specified Model GWAS Issue
parts:
To whom it may concern,

When I perform my user GWAS, I get the following error:

CorrelatedFactors<-userGWAS(covstruc = LDSCoutput_IntTrait_onlyFive, SNPs = CHR21, estimation = "DWLS", model = FourFactmodel, printwarn = TRUE,sub=c("F1~SNP", "F2~SNP","F3~SNP","F4~SNP"), cores = NULL, toler = FALSE, SNPSE = FALSE, parallel = FALSE,GC="standard",MPI=FALSE,smooth_check=FALSE)

Error in solve.default(t(S2.delt) %*% S2.W %*% S2.delt, tol = toler) : system is computationally singular: reciprocal condition number = 1.93203e-20

LDSCoutput_IntTrait_onlyFive:



Model:
FourFactmodel<-"F1 =~ Phen1+Phen2+Phen3
F2=~NA*Phen4+Phen3+Phen5
F1 ~~ F2
Phen4~~a*Phen4
a>.001
F3=~Phen3
Phen3~~0*Phen3
F1 ~~ 0*F3
F2 ~~ 0*F3
F4=~Phen5
Phen5~~0*Phen5
F2 ~~ 0*F4
F3 ~~ 0*F4
F1 ~ SNP
F2 ~ SNP
F3 ~ SNP
F4 ~ SNP"

Thanks for your help,

Anthony

messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: User Specified Model GWAS Issue
parts:
Hi Anthony,
It doesn't look like you have an identification constraint for F2 so your model probably isn't identified. Try removing the NA before the loading of Phen4 so that you have unit loading identification for F2.
Btw, I would recommend trying the model out without SNPs to make sure it converges before adding in SNPs.
Elliot
